name: Legacy Founder
description: One young adult, §1,800 and an empty lot. Reach the top of a career, build a house worth §75,000 and produce an heir - all in 28 days. Bulldoze the lot before you start.

goals.description: Have an heir (a child or teen in the household)

win.notification: Your founder did it: career, house and heir. The legacy begins.

lose.notification: 28 days gone. The founder's story ends here.
